First exploration includes direct loot and one possible bonus find. Fully looted also includes every object searched, gathered and dismantled, assuming you have the tools and complete the actions.

Bonus-find odds assume no previous discoveries. Repeat finds change the odds. Shoreline totals include the extra cattail patches beside a river or lake.
